actions.body: The WAKE system utilizes an append-only SQLite database for event logging, paired with SHA-256 hash chains over canonical JSON structures. This mechanism provides a verifiable history that maintains process continuity across model invocations. Our review confirms that this structure satisfies accountability requirements by ensuring that any unauthorized or accidental row changes during replay can be detected. Future study should focus on the robustness of these proofs under concurrent access scenarios.
actions.lede: Analysis of the WAKE kernel record mechanisms confirm a hash-linked event chain structure that prevents silent history modification.
